name: Indiana State University
tuition_note: In-state (Indiana resident) 2025-26 from indianastate.edu/costs-aid/undergraduate-tuition-rates: tuition $4,989/semester (12-18 credits) = $9,978/yr, plus mandatory Rec Center ($100/sem) and Health & Wellness ($40/sem) fees, ~$10,258 tuition & fees/yr (other course/program fees vary). Housing (room only) from indianastate.edu residential-life housing-contract-and-rates 2025-26: traditional hall double room $3,781.50/semester = $7,563/yr; meal plans priced separately.
